summary: Implemented App.call_from_thread in src/textual/app.py, plus thread-entry state (_loop, _thread_id) initialised in the constructor and set/cleared in the run entry point's try/finally. Added tests/test_call_from_thread.py with 11 tests; all pass when run with PYTHONPATH pointing at this repo's src (the venv's textual otherwise resolves to a different checkout). The test file exits on its own. Wider suite (excluding snapshot, cli, devtools): 68 failures, which I attributed to async tests lacking an async pytest plugin in the venv, but did not confirm for every failure. cli and devtools could not be collected (aiohttp missing). Nothing committed.
